_sources: provisions: 1961 s.56 / 2025 s.92 (coverage MODELLED, D-208). summary: S2 s.92(1), (2); 1961 s.56(1), (2). routes: OS-INTEREST (s.92(2)(e)), OS-DIVIDEND ((a)), OS-KEYMAN-POLICY ((d)), OS-FORFEITED-ADVANCE ((h)), OS-TERMINATION-COMPENSATION ((j)), OS-BUSINESS-TRUST ((k)), OS-LIFE-POLICY ((l), with Schedule II Sl. 2 and OS-LIFE-POLICY-RATIO / -PREMIUM), OS-GIFT ((m), (3); 1961 also OS-GIFT-COVID-DEATH), OS-RESIDUAL ((1); also unit income, sources/2026-10-22-unit-income.md, D-321). OS-COMPENSATION-INTEREST-INCOME ((2)(i)) charges interest on compensation, deducted under SEC-OTHER-SOURCES-DEDUCTIONS. disqualifiers[0]: s.92(2)(b) winnings, 1961 s.115BB DEFERRED (D-193). disqualifiers[1]: s.92(2)(c), (f), (g), deductions in the business head, DEFERRED (D-202). disqualifiers[2]: s.18(1)(a), (c)(iii) — employer compensation and an employee's Keyman sums are salary (D-203). disqualifiers[3]: Schedule II Sl. 2 excludes life-policy sums meeting its conditions (OS-LIFE-POLICY-RATIO; D-205, D-207). disqualifiers[4]: s.67(5) — a ULIP's sums not excluded are capital gains, W-088. disqualifiers[5]: s.92(3) gift exclusions (GiftExclusion; D-201).
summary: Income that belongs to no other head is income from other sources: interest, dividends, gifts above a limit, sums from a life policy that are not exempt, a forfeited advance, compensation on leaving a job paid by someone other than the employer, a business trust's distributions beyond what was put in, and anything else of the kind. Each is taken in full or by the rule for its kind.

routes.name: Interest
routes.description: Interest on securities, deposits and any other interest.

routes.name: Gifts
routes.description: Sums and property received free or below value, above the limit.

routes.name: Life policy sums
routes.description: Sums from a life policy that are not exempt, beyond the premiums paid.

routes.name: Keyman policy sums
routes.description: Keyman policy sums that are not salary or business income.

routes.name: Forfeited advance
routes.description: An advance kept when a sale of a capital asset falls through.

routes.name: Compensation on leaving a job
routes.description: Compensation from someone other than the employer.

routes.name: Business trust distributions
routes.description: What a business trust paid out beyond the unit's issue price and earlier charges.

routes.name: Any other income
routes.description: Income from mutual fund units, and income that fits no other head and none of the kinds above.

disqualifiers.description: Winnings from lotteries, races, games or betting are taxed at a rate of their own and are not computed here.

enforcedBy.reason: their special rate is deferred in the coverage register

disqualifiers.description: Sums from employees for their funds, and letting machinery, plant or furniture, are not computed here.

enforcedBy.reason: their deductions belong to the business head, deferred with it

disqualifiers.description: Compensation from your employer on leaving, and Keyman sums you receive as an employee, are salary, not this head.
Life policy sums that meet the exemption's conditions are not income.
Unit linked policy sums that are not exempt are capital gains and are not computed here.

enforcedBy.reason: capital gains are not built yet

disqualifiers.description: Gifts from a relative, on marriage, by will or inheritance, and the other excluded sources are not income.
